scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --external:cloudflare:sockets --banner:js='// Telegram WEB proxy for Cloudflare Workers, single-file build. Generated by "npm run bundle" from src/ — edit src/, not this file.' --outfile=worker.js

SECRET.description: Choose **any password of at least 8 characters** (longer is safer). After deploy, open your Worker address followed by `/` and your password, for example `https://YOUR-WORKER.workers.dev/YOUR-PASSWORD`, to get your Telegram proxy link. Keep it private.
